mentions.note: ran for N.F.S. in second race, 3rd, 28.7; 14th in third race (Epsom), 33.44; 2nd in fourth race, 42.49; "Fireman Hoath (also a Bel)" won fifth race by 1¼ minutes in 44.35

3rd Southern Counties 5 miles, Belgrave Hall, 30.57; 1st Southern Counties 5 miles, Dartford, 27.18; 4th Southern Counties 5 miles, Ruislip, 31.59; 2nd Southern Counties 7½ miles, Hayes (Kent), 45.31; 2nd Southern Counties 7½ miles, Epsom, 40.34; 3rd Southern Counties v. Army Units, Wimbledon
2nd at Hayes; not among the "A" team scorers listed (3, 4, 8, 10)

share.d: Hoath in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1942–1945: 8 mentions in 5 issues and 7 race results.
